description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a Fragment subclass used in Android development. It creates and manages a user interface component that displays log messages within a ScrollView. The class sets up the view hierarchy, initializes a custom LogView widget, and handles text change events to keep the log view scrolled to the latest entries.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that provides a view for displaying logs via a LogView within a ScrollView. It supports initializing views, customizing appearance, and keeping the latest log entries visible.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, applies styling and padding, and returns the root view.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Lifecycle method that inflates the views, sets up a listener to scroll to the bottom when text changes, and returns the view hierarchy.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
